youtube.title: Hickory Dickory Dock 🕰️ Count the Bongs 1 to 4 Sing-Along for Toddlers | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Sing Hickory Dickory Dock with Robo and count the bongs! Every hour a different friend goes up the big grandfather clock: a mouse at one o'clock, a frog at two, a duck at three and a cat at four. Count the bongs on your fingers, see where the little hand points, shout up or down, and guess which animal is next. Then a point-to-it quiz and one last song with everyone.

What your child learns: counting 1 to 4 (one bong, two bongs...), the words up and down, and that the little hand on the clock points to the hour.

Sing at home: say "Bong!" and hold up a finger for each one, point up and down with the animals, and ask "Who's next?" before each verse. The first verse of Hickory Dickory Dock is a traditional public-domain rhyme; the verses for two, three and four o'clock and the last chorus are original words written for Toy Box Friends.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.

do.text: Four friends will climb the clock! Count the bongs with me!
Who climbs at four o'clock? A surprise!
I see little pink ears! Who is it?
The mouse ran up the clock.
Count the bongs with me! Hold up a finger!
The little blue hand points to one!
Look at the mouse! Up or down?
I see green feet! Who is it?
The frog jumped up the clock.
Count the bongs! Hold up your fingers!
The little blue hand points to two!
Look at the frog! Up or down?
I see an orange beak! Who is it?
The duck flew up the clock.
Count the bongs! Hold up your fingers!
Three bongs! The little hand points to three!
Look at the duck! Up or down?
I see pointy ears! Who is it?
The cat climbed up the clock.
Count the bongs! Hold up your fingers!
Four bongs! The little hand points to four!
Look at the cat! Up or down?
Who ran up at one o'clock? Point to it!
Who flew up the clock? Point to it!
We all ran up the clock!
